'''2017 MPC Bill Kafer LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Bill Kafer]] at [[2017 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Player:''' [[Bill Kafer]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Match Play Championship]]
